content:
maria: Thinking out loud — what if we add a tiny 'launchpad' set of bot commands + one-page release cookbook so engineers can run common release ops without opening the runbook every time?

simon: love it. can we scope to 3 commands first: start, promote, rollback? keep them idempotent and safe flags. :thumbsup:

aj: +1. also need a standard template for release notes and pinning lines so on-call can quickly verify version pins.

riley: sketch of commands i had in mind:```/launch start --template=quick --change-window=2026-03-25T22:00Z --canary=10% /launch promote --to=stable --verify=smoke /launch rollback --from=stable --reason="regression" --force=false```

maria: perfect. important: default --force=false and require human confirmation for rollback unless urgent tag set. ops-bot: can we enforce a 5-min review timeout before promote?

ops-bot: action: add 5m manual hold on /launch promote when canary < 30%. Notify #eng-oncall.

simon: for the release notes template, propose this minimal structure:````- Summary: one line
- Owners: @team
- Changes: bullet list with link to PRs
- Rollout plan: canary %, regions, window
- Rollback plan: exact command to run```

aj: include a pinned snippet for version pinning in service manifests:```image: registry.redwood.ai/service@sha256:abcdef1234567890```

riley: also add a quick lint check in the bot for missing rollback plan in release notes. if missing, bot responds with `:warning: missing rollback plan — please add or add --force-override`

maria: operational controls:
- bot should auto-add change-window to UTC and show local equivalent
- bot must include cost estimate for big models (if model-serving changes)
- require @sre ack for database-affecting releases

simon: edge case: partial model pins across regions. command should accept `--regions us-east,eu-west` and do staged promotes.

aj: testing idea: add `--dry-run` that prints all steps, generated rollout notes, and the exact rollback command without making changes. keeps runbooks reproducible.

release-bot: note: added /launch dry-run support on staging. Use `--template=canary` to auto-generate canary plan.

riley: who owns the cookbook doc? i can draft a one-pager and a set of CLI aliases for common flows (hotfix, data-migration, model-rollout).

maria: assign to riley. Simon will review. Aj will add the lint rule for rollback plan. Ops-bot: create a follow-up ticket for Canaries dashboard link.

ops-bot: ticket created: RL-4387 — Add canary dashboard link + 5m promote hold.

simon: timeline? would be great to ship this as a small UX improvement before next Friday's deploy window.

riley: i'll aim for a draft PR by Wednesday. PR will include: bot command docs, two templates (quick, canary), and one-pager cookbook.

maria: awesome. if anyone else has objections to defaults (5m hold, 10% canary default), raise now. otherwise i'll close this thread tomorrow and tag owners on the task. :shipit:

aj: no objections from me. thanks!

simon: fine by me. make sure the CLI respects 'pin file' detection in the repo.

maria: noted. closing in 24h unless someone requests changes.

-- end of thread --
